source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: getIdealDialogPosition returns CSS pixel strings from viewport rectangles. Its unit test passes those rectangles directly. The browser fixture instead applies left/top styles inside a container, shows a real dialog and compares numeric DOMRect positions. Container offsets therefore change some browser expectations; the two tables are not interchangeable merely because their labels match. The fixed PositionedDialog also has later height, missing-trigger and resize cleanup refinements. All changed cases were read statically; no layout, resize or browser/unit test ran.
title: Dialog position tests use distinct pure and DOM coordinate spaces
